item.title: Global supply lines at risk: Iran’s Strait of Hormuz warning sends shock through global trade
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz has long been viewed as one of the most sensitive geopolitical flashpoints in the world. Its geography gives Iran control over its northern coastline, while Oman sits to the south, creating a bottleneck where even limited military action — or the threat of it — can disrupt global trade.

item.title: US-Israel Attacks Iran LIVE Updates: Italian defense minister was stuck in Dubai with his family
item.description: Israel-Iran War LIVE Updates: Iran in ratalition hit US bases in Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, UAE. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) reportedly launched attacks on multiple US military bases in Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, and the UAE, according to FARS News Agency.

item.title: Ali Khamenei dead: The cleric who shaped Iran for over three decades
item.description: Ali Khamenei, the son of a religious scholar, was born in 1939 in Mashhad. In 1962, he joined Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini's opposition movement against Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi

item.title: 209 billion barrels: Iran’s oil muscle looms over global markets as conflict escalates
item.description: Sanctions have curbed its ability to sell freely, yet Iran continues to export an estimated 1.3 to 1.5 million bpd of crude, with the majority heading to China. In 2023, its net oil export revenues were estimated at $53 billion, up from $37 billion in 2021.

item.title: Iran state TV confirms Supreme Leader Khamenei dead; daughter and grandchild also killed in strikes
item.description: The announcement was followed by claims from Fars News Agency - affiliated with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps - that members of Khamenei's family were also killed in the attacks.

item.title: Why Iran struck Dubai despite no official US military base
item.description: When the joint operation unfolded on Saturday, Iran launched retaliatory strikes across Qatar, Bahrain, Jordan, and Kuwait - all home to US military facilities. But Iran also struck the UAE, a country that does not host a formal US military base
